description: List compute instances in a region, optionally filtered by tags. Paginated: returns {page, per_page, pages, items}. Passwords are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/instances.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

name: civo_list_instances
title: List instances
